subject: Communication Systems
questionText:
An AM modulator has output
x(t) = A cos 400πt + B cos380πt + B cos 420πt
The carrier power is 100 W and the efficiency of 40%.
The values of A and B are
 (a)
14.14, 8.16
(b) 50, 10
(c)
22.36, 13.46
(d) None of the above
explanation: Practice Question from Communication Systems DPP-01 (Analog Communication AM & FM).
